newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech rains seen easing, river levels fall.
newsitem.headline: Czech rains seen easing, river levels fall.

text.p: Light rain fell across the flood-battered Czech Republic on Monday but forecasters said a break in the weather was in sight and that rivers were gradually falling.
More than 40 people have been killed in the eastern Czech Republic in two weeks of severe flooding triggered by days of torrential rain.
The Czech Weather Service forecast just showers for later on Monday and Tuesday and little if any rain on Wednesday and Thursday.
"We expect the water levels to continue to fall," said meteorologist Frantisek Sopko.

Heavy rain at the weekend raised already swollen rivers and put many towns and villages in the east of the country on emergency alert. But there were few reports of flooding, and rivers began to fall on Sunday evening.
